question: According to the National Multidimensional Poverty Index Progress report 2023, how many people escaped multidimensional poverty between 2015-2021 in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**13.5 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• According to the National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) Progress Report 2023, **13.5 crore people in India** escaped multidimensional poverty between 2015 and 2021.
 
• The report is based on an analysis of data from the **National Family Health Survey (NFHS)**, conducted during this time period.
